text: He was awarded the Wound Badge in April, 1945.

He was awarded the Wound Badge in April, 1945. Reading his entries you realise what kind of man he was.He served to the very end. Not many would today.A soldier's soldier, whatever side he was on.Three years at the front without a blemish. Says it all.We could use a few like him now.Hard not to admire the men this was issued to.
